away.summary: The Wild (14-3-4) are projected to start Jesper Wallstedt in net against the Bruins. Defenseman Brock Faber is expected to make his season debut after recovering from a preseason skull fracture and surgery, though coach John Hynes had not finalized his defensive pairing. Filip Gustavsson is out with a lower-body injury, while Nico Sturm, David Spacek, and Matt Kiersted are listed as scratched.

home.summary: The Bruins (13-5-1) are projected to start Jeremy Swayman in goal. Connor Clifton is expected to return to the lineup after being a healthy scratch for the past five games and will be paired with Frederic Brunet. Mason Lohrei will be a healthy scratch, and Jonathan Aspirot, Sean Kuraly, and Mason Lohrei are listed as scratched.
